title: 独立家用厨刀

source.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: reusable transparent paper-theatre animation cutout. Primary request: one standalone chef's kitchen knife for a Chinese home cooking preparation scene. Subject: single modest stainless-steel chef knife with matte pale wooden handle, broad clean blade and clear handle/blade connection, shown diagonally with blade edge facing down, no hand, no food, no board. Style/medium: refined tactile cut-paper collage with subtle paper fiber, restrained steel and warm wood, crisp silhouette. Composition/framing: one object centered and fully visible with generous transparent margin. Background: genuinely transparent alpha. Constraints: ordinary kitchen utensil only; no gore, no person, no background card, no cast shadow, no glow, no text, no logo, no watermark.

discovery.usage_notes: 独立道具层；不含手、不含食材、不表达具体切割结果。

usage_notes: 与砧板、蔬菜或鱼肉独立排景；不表示真实刀工或食物安全教学。
